name: Dzharaonyx
sum: Alvarezsaurid from the Turonian Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan, known from isolated bones collected since the 1970s.
holotype: A bone from the Dzharakuduk locality, Bissekty Formation, Kyzylkum Desert, Uzbekistan (Averianov and Sues 2022).
material: A few isolated bones from Dzharakuduk; only seven alvarezsaur bones were known among over 3,500 dinosaur fossils catalogued from the site by 2017.
biology: One of the few Central Asian alvarezsaurids of mid-Cretaceous age.
author: Averianov and Sues 2022

sources.text: A. O. Averianov and H.-D. Sues. 2022. New material and diagnosis of a new taxon of alvarezsaurid (Dinosauria, Theropoda) from the Upper Cretaceous Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 41(5):e2036174
